info.title: Sakari
info.description: Sakari is a business messaging platform for sending and tracking SMS and MMS at scale. This connector manages contacts, messages, conversations, templates, campaigns, drip campaigns, autoresponders, tracked links and webhooks in a Sakari account.

tags.name: messages
tags.description: Send or track messages to one contact, a group of contacts or your entire address book

tags.name: templates
tags.description: Define reusable message or web templates

tags.name: campaigns
tags.description: Define reusable message campaigns with a predefined contact list/filter, template and schedule

tags.name: conversations
tags.description: Conversations group your message history with each contact into one thread

tags.name: tools
tags.description: Tools to assist with sending and receiving messages, such as file sharing, translation, etc.

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description: Webhooks allow your own system to be automatically notified upon certin events, such as a new message received from one of your contacts or a status change notification for your messages

get.description: Retrieves the current balance of the account.
Lists the autoresponders configured for the account.

post.description: Creates an autoresponder that replies automatically to matching incoming messages.

get.description: Retrieves an autoresponder by its ID.

delete.description: Removes an autoresponder from the account.

200.description: Confirmation that the autoresponder was removed

get.description: Searches for phone numbers available to add to the account, filtered by country, type, area code and other criteria.

200.description: The phone numbers available to add to the account

get.description: Lists the account's contacts, optionally filtered by name, mobile number, email or tags.

200.description: A page of contacts matching the filters
